slots.note: The rare slot. A parallel here (about 1 a box) can be an SR or a Leader, which plays as its base card.

specials.note: Special art printings, about 2 a case of 12 boxes, in place of the rare slot; each plays as its base card.
Treasure Rare printings, about 1 a case, in place of the rare slot; each plays as its base card.
